comment: * This class provides methods to retreive information from the CarrierKeyProvider.

variables.name: RESET_CARRIER_KEY_RATE_LIMIT
variables.comment:
* Rate limit (in milliseconds) the number of times the Carrier keys can be reset.
    * Do it at most once every 12 hours.

variables.name: EPDG_BACKUP_KEY_ID
variables.comment: Key ID used with the backup key from carrier config

variables.name: mLastAccessResetCarrierKey
variables.comment: Last time the resetCarrierKeysForImsiEncryption API was called successfully.

methods.comment:
* Returns Carrier specific information that will be used to encrypt the IMSI and IMPI.
     * @param keyType whether the key is being used for WLAN or ePDG.
     * @param context
     * @param fallback whether to fallback to the IMSI key info stored in carrier config
     * @return ImsiEncryptionInfo which contains the information, including the public key, to be
     *         used for encryption.

methods.name: public static void setCarrierInfoForImsiEncryption(ImsiEncryptionInfo imsiEncryptionInfo, Context context, int phoneId)
methods.comment:
* Sets the Carrier specific information that will be used to encrypt the IMSI and IMPI.
     * This includes the public key and the key identifier. This information will be stored in the
     * device keystore.
     * @param imsiEncryptionInfo which includes the Key Type, the Public Key
     *        {@link java.security.PublicKey} and the Key Identifier.
     *        The keyIdentifier Attribute value pair that helps a server locate
     *        the private key to decrypt the permanent identity.
     * @param context Context.

methods.comment:

     *  2. Send an intent to download new Certificates.

     *
